provenance.origin: synthetic — tests the DSP, not the device
provenance.purpose: OxyDex math-correctness known-answer battery (Target 1). Every expected value below was hand-computed, never derived by running OxyDex.

flat_normal.description: Flat 97% night. No desaturations, no time below threshold. The control: nothing should be found.

nadir_gappy.description: The minimum (82) sits inside a gap (nulls at indices 4-6). The reported nadir must be the lowest MEASURED value (88), never the gap interior.

nadir_single.description: Single desaturation: 10 samples, minimum 88 at index 5. Tests nadir value and elapsed-clock placement.

threshold_edge.description: Samples at 90 and 89. Tests time-below-threshold counting: 3 samples below 90 (indices 3,4,5 at 89), 0 below 88.
